items.title: Go 1.28 Will Let You Write return {}, err
items.blurb: Go 1.28 is set to let you drop the type from a composite literal when the compiler can infer it from the place where the value goes.

items.title: Making Games with the Entity Component System Pattern
items.blurb: Entity Component System (ECS) is how I structure my hobby games in Go. I show it on two small games built with Donburi and Ebitengine and explain where ECS gets in the way.
